_meta.description: Curated FACTS from community walkthroughs (enemy faction, the unit types the enemy attacks with, attack pattern, objective), cross-referenced against each mission's AI-script attack composition. Facts only, attributed by source URL - not walkthrough prose. Missions absent here have script-derived data only; this is a hand-researched subset meant to be extended.
_meta.cross_reference: walkthrough enemy_units vs the mission's script attack composition (tools/ai/mission_bot.py). Names normalised (race prefix + plural stripped). confirmed = in both; script_only = the bot attacks with it but the walkthrough didn't note it; walkthrough_only = the walkthrough saw it but no AI attack wave contains it (often trigger-spawned or defensive).

terran/terran03.name: Desperate Alliance
terran/terran03.objective: Survive 30 minutes; no offensive objective (pure defence)
terran/terran03.attack_pattern: escalating waves against two choke points until the 30-minute timer

terran/terran05.name: Revolution
terran/terran05.objective: Destroy the Confederate Alpha Squadron base on Antiga Prime
terran/terran05.attack_pattern: ground pushes plus occasional Siege Tanks; bunkers and spider mines on defence

terran/terran07.name: The Trump Card
terran/terran07.objective: Deliver the Psi Emitter to the beacon (it lures the Zerg onto Delta Squadron)
terran/terran07.attack_pattern: Delta Squadron ground forces + cloaked Wraiths early; the Psi Emitter then draws heavy Zerg waves

zerg/zerg02.name: Egression
zerg/zerg02.objective: Escort the Chrysalis to the beacon in the bottom-right corner
zerg/zerg02.attack_pattern: Photon-cannon/Zealot defences on the path; Dragoons and Scouts join as you advance

protoss/protoss01.name: First Strike
protoss/protoss01.objective: Meet Fenix at Antioch, then wipe out the Zerg base
protoss/protoss01.attack_pattern: scattered Zergling/Hydralisk groups on the approach; base defended by a sunken colony
